summary: Mergeable PR that fixes a regression in SQLite's handling of nullable OneToOneField. However, it's unclear if this is the most minimal fix.

issues.description: There's a risk of behavioral regression if this fix isn't fully backward compatible with existing migrations.
It would be good to add additional tests to ensure this fix doesn't introduce any new issues.
The fix is not entirely minimal, as it modifies the existing logic in DatabaseSchemaEditor.
The code style and formatting are consistent with the repo, but it would be good to add a docstring to explain the reasoning behind this change.
